checks: Independently verified the linked revision byte digest. Only the single-plane scope sentence in the statement differs. The proof, source bindings, and all other claims have identical bytes after JSON field decoding.

The actual census is 3L equal fibers. A finite binary tilt with zero own-layer contribution and strictly negative other-layer margins preserves each own continuous cap trace. Layer-center symmetry supplies lower bound q, and two opposite median caps give a whole-plane upper cover of budget q. At z=±1, a further finite tilt pays at most w/2 by isolating the extreme own fiber.

For each fixed exposing plane, small offset below its strict gap to all other measured fibers affects one layer. A different layer retains its old center lower bound q. All original covering cap masses remain ≤q after deletion. This gives the exact normalized ratio for that fixed plane.

For 0<t≤1 each selected cube cut removes a d-simplex of mass δ=t^d/d! only from (1,η), with boundary null. Layer-isolating tilts can be chosen large enough also for the translated caps. The three closed traces cover the entire plane because failure of the first two implies the third. The removed simplex has nonnegative coordinates and strictly positive first-two coordinate sum, so it is in the first two and disjoint from the third.

The first two cap budgets are q−2δ/3 and the diagonal budget adds δ²/(9q), by the old triangular area (2−h)^2/2 and the common other-coordinate factor. The quotient simplifies to the displayed strict gap, and δ<w gives w<(3w−δ)/2. The three proper old cap slopes are q,q,√2 q and the balance weights 1,1,√2, giving the claimed diagonal game. A missing vertex makes a row zero.

The ordinary and paired value for the box is 1/2 by central reflection and the zero-shift upper bound. The protected old value is 2^(−n), above the sharper Γ_d 2^(−n) target. The finite descent certificate compares to this old value.
Checked the exact source locators and matched all archived candidate hashes against the pinned graph.

issues.defect: The unqualified phrase every sufficiently small trim of a plane exposing a single point can assert one smallness neighborhood uniform in the plane. The proof only supplies a cutoff after the plane is fixed. In n=d=2, with q=6, choose the unique-vertex exposing functional z+(t/10)k+x₁+x₂ and trim its offset by t, 0<t≤1. Both z=1 binary layers are cut, deleting δ₁=t²/2 and δ₀=(81/100)δ₁. The same per-layer three-cap calculation gives a global upper bound [q−2δ₀/3+δ₀²/(9q)]/[4q−δ₀−δ₁]<1/4 since (5/3)δ₀−4δ₀²/(9q)>δ₁. This family has removed mass tending to zero and contradicts uniform protection.
